items.prompt: Complete B's reply with 把…成….
items.sub: More than one card may fit.

segments.traditional: 我常看你的部落格，內容很充實而且獨特，可以寫小說了。
segments.simplified: 我常看你的部落格，内容很充实而且独特，可以写小说了。

options.note: This card is about finding someone (找); A is talking about writing a novel.

options.traditional: ～我旅遊時難忘的經驗 V～一本書
options.simplified: ～我旅游时难忘的经验 V～一本书

result.traditional: 謝謝！我正打算把我旅遊時難忘的經驗寫成一本書。
result.simplified: 谢谢！我正打算把我旅游时难忘的经验写成一本书。
result.pinyin: Xièxie! Wǒ zhèngzài dǎsuàn bǎ wǒ lǚyóu shí nán wàng de jīngyàn xiě chéng yì běn shū.
result.english: Thanks! I plan to write my unforgettable travel experiences into a book.

options.note: This card is about 往 and 住, which have nothing to do with A's writing.

options.traditional: ～發生在自己身上的故事 V～小說
options.simplified: ～发生在自己身上的故事 V～小说

result.traditional: 謝謝！我正打算把發生在自己身上的故事寫成小說。
result.simplified: 谢谢！我正打算把发生在自己身上的故事写成小说。
result.pinyin: Xièxie! Wǒ zhèngzài dǎsuàn bǎ fāshēng zài zìjǐ shēnshang de gùshi xiě chéng xiǎoshuō.
result.english: Thanks! I plan to turn the story that happened to me into a novel.

items.prompt: Complete B's reply with 把…成….
items.sub: More than one card may fit.

segments.traditional: 「白」跟「自」這兩個字太像了，我老是弄錯。
segments.simplified: 「白」跟「自」这两个字太像了，我老是弄错。

options.note: This card is about finding someone (找), not about characters that look alike.

options.traditional: ～我旅遊時難忘的經驗 V～一本書

result.traditional: 嗯。我也常把「往」看成「住」。
result.simplified: 嗯。我也常把「往」看成「住」。
result.pinyin: Èn. Wǒ yě cháng bǎ wǎng kànchéng zhù.
result.english: Yes. I also often mistake 往 for 住.

options.traditional: ～發生在自己身上的故事 V～小說
options.simplified: ～发生在自己身上的故事 V～小说

options.traditional: 你們把蛋糕切成七塊
options.simplified: 你们把蛋糕切成七块

result.traditional: 你們把蛋糕切成七塊，剛好一人一塊。
result.simplified: 你们把蛋糕切成七块，刚好一人一块。
result.pinyin: Nǐmen bǎ dàngāo qiē chéng qī kuài, gānghǎo yí rén yí kuài.
result.english: You cut the cake into seven pieces, so everyone gets one.

options.traditional: 你們切成七塊蛋糕
options.simplified: 你们切成七块蛋糕
options.note: The 把 is missing; the thing you change goes after 把.

options.traditional: 你們把蛋糕看成七塊
options.simplified: 你们把蛋糕看成七块
options.note: 看成 means to mistake one thing for another; you are cutting the cake, not mistaking it.

segments.traditional: 這是我們七個人一起送給你的蛋糕。祝你生日快樂！
segments.simplified: 这是我们七个人一起送给你的蛋糕。祝你生日快乐！

sentence.traditional: 把蛋糕切成七塊，剛好一人一塊。
sentence.simplified: 把蛋糕切成七块，刚好一人一块。
sentence.pinyin: Bǎ dàngāo qiē chéng qī kuài, gānghǎo yí rén yí kuài.
sentence.english: Cut the cake into seven pieces, so each person gets one.

repairs.note: 寫 means to write; here you are cutting the cake, so use 切.

items.fallbackRepair: Build 把 + 蛋糕 + 切 + 成 + 七塊.
items.sub: A：這是我們七個人一起送給你的蛋糕。祝你生日快樂！

options.traditional: 你是不是把糖看成鹽了？
options.simplified: 你是不是把糖看成盐了？

result.traditional: 你是不是把糖看成鹽了？
result.simplified: 你是不是把糖看成盐了？
result.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì bǎ táng kànchéng yán le?
result.english: Did you mistake the sugar for salt?

options.traditional: 你是不是把鹽看成糖了？
options.simplified: 你是不是把盐看成糖了？
options.note: This reverses the mistake: the sugar went in and was taken for salt, not the other way round.

options.traditional: 你是不是把糖放成鹽了？
options.simplified: 你是不是把糖放成盐了？
options.note: 放成 puts one thing into another state; the mistake is about identity, so use 看成.

situation.traditional: 你朋友煮的湯太甜了，你覺得他可能想放鹽，可是放錯了。你怎麼跟他說？
situation.simplified: 你朋友煮的汤太甜了，你觉得他可能想放盐，可是放错了。你怎么跟他说？
situation.english: Your friend's soup is too sweet. You think he meant to add salt, but he added sugar by mistake. What do you say?

sentence.pinyin: Bǎ táng kànchéng yán le.
sentence.english: (He) mistook the sugar for salt.

repairs.note: 嚐 means to taste; the mistake is in what he took for salt, not in tasting.

items.fallbackRepair: Build 把 + 糖 + 看 + 成 + 鹽了.

situation.traditional: 你朋友煮的湯太甜了，你覺得他可能想放鹽，可是放錯了。你怎麼跟他說？
situation.simplified: 你朋友煮的汤太甜了，你觉得他可能想放盐，可是放错了。你怎么跟他说？
situation.english: Your friend's soup is too sweet. You think he meant to add salt, but he added sugar by mistake. What do you say?

options.traditional: 房東把我當成家人
options.simplified: 房东把我当成家人

result.traditional: 房東把我當成家人。
result.simplified: 房东把我当成家人。
result.pinyin: Fángdōng bǎ wǒ dāngchéng jiārén.
result.english: The landlord treats me like family.

options.traditional: 房東把家人當成我
options.simplified: 房东把家人当成我
options.note: This reverses it: the landlord treats you as family, not family as you.

options.traditional: 房東把我看成家人
options.simplified: 房东把我看成家人
options.note: 看成 means mistaking one thing for another; she is not mistaken, she treats you as family.

situation.traditional: 你朋友覺得很奇怪，為什麼房東那麼關心你，還常常幫你打掃房間。你怎麼跟朋友說？
situation.simplified: 你朋友觉得很奇怪，为什么房东那么关心你，还常常帮你打扫房间。你怎么跟朋友说？
situation.english: Your friend wonders why your landlord cares so much and often cleans your room. What do you say?

sentence.pinyin: Bǎ wǒ dāngchéng jiārén.
sentence.english: (She) treats me like family.

repairs.note: 看成 says she mistook you for someone else; she treats you as family, so use 當成.

items.fallbackRepair: Build 把 + 我 + 當 + 成 + 家人.

situation.traditional: 你朋友覺得很奇怪，為什麼房東那麼關心你，還常常幫你打掃房間。你怎麼跟朋友說？
situation.simplified: 你朋友觉得很奇怪，为什么房东那么关心你，还常常帮你打扫房间。你怎么跟朋友说？
situation.english: Your friend wonders why your landlord cares so much and often cleans your room. What do you say?

options.traditional: 你把它畫成龍了？一點都不像耶。
options.simplified: 你把它画成龙了？一点都不像耶。

result.traditional: 你把它畫成龍了？一點都不像耶。
result.simplified: 你把它画成龙了？一点都不像耶。
result.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ tā huà chéng lóng le? Yì diǎn dōu bú xiàng ye.
result.english: You drew it as a dragon? It doesn't look like one at all.

options.traditional: 你把龍畫成它了，一點都不像
options.simplified: 你把龙画成它了，一点都不像
options.note: This reverses it: the dragon was turned into the animal, not the animal into a dragon.

options.traditional: 你把它看成龍，一點都不像
options.simplified: 你把它看成龙，一点都不像
options.note: 看成 means to mistake one thing for another; he drew it, so use 畫成.

situation.traditional: 你的美國朋友畫了一隻動物，很興奮地對你說：「這條龍好看嗎？」但是你覺得一點都不像。你怎麼跟他說？
situation.simplified: 你的美国朋友画了一只动物，很兴奋地对你说：「这条龙好看吗？」但是你觉得一点都不像。你怎么跟他说？
situation.english: Your American friend drew an animal and excitedly asks if this dragon is nice. You think it doesn't look like one at all. What do you say?

sentence.pinyin: Bǎ tā huà chéng lóng le.
sentence.english: (You) drew it as a dragon.

repairs.note: 看 would only mean looking at it; the reply says he drew it as a dragon, so use 畫成.

items.fallbackRepair: Build 把 + 它 + 畫 + 成 + 龍了.

situation.traditional: 你的美國朋友畫了一隻動物，很興奮地對你說：「這條龍好看嗎？」但是你覺得一點都不像。你怎麼跟他說？
situation.simplified: 你的美国朋友画了一只动物，很兴奋地对你说：「这条龙好看吗？」但是你觉得一点都不像。你怎么跟他说？
situation.english: Your American friend drew an animal and excitedly asks if this dragon is nice. You think it doesn't look like one at all. What do you say?

items.prompt: Complete B's reply with 再…也/都….

sentence.traditional: 我們很久沒見面了，再累也要去。
sentence.simplified: 我们很久没见面了，再累也要去。

sentence.traditional: 我們很久沒見面了，再累都要去。
sentence.simplified: 我们很久没见面了，再累都要去。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒmen hěn jiǔ méi jiànmiàn le, zài lèi dōu yào qù.
sentence.english: We haven't seen each other in ages, so no matter how tired I am, I'll go.

options.traditional: 再難寫，也要多練習
options.simplified: 再难写，也要多练习

result.traditional: 再難寫，也要多練習。
result.simplified: 再难写，也要多练习。

options.traditional: 難寫，也要多練習

options.note: Contradicts the advice: 也 keeps the decision to practice, so 不練習 cannot follow.

situation.traditional: 你學生覺得寫漢字不容易，所以不願意練習，可是你覺得寫漢字中文才進步得快。你怎麼跟他說？

sentence.pinyin: Zài nán xiě, yě yào duō liànxí.
sentence.english: No matter how hard they are to write, you still have to practice a lot.

repairs.note: 只要 gives a plain condition; 再 is needed to say even the hardest case.

items.fallbackRepair: Build 再 + 難寫 + 也 + 要 + 多練習.

situation.traditional: 你學生覺得寫漢字不容易，所以不願意練習，可是你覺得寫漢字中文才進步得快。你怎麼跟他說？

options.simplified: 再紧张，也要好好表现

B3L08-G03-P213.title: Complete the dialogues and answer the situations.

items.prompt: Complete A's question with V得慣 or V不慣.

sentence.traditional: 你住在日本一段時間了，吃得慣納豆嗎？
sentence.simplified: 你住在日本一段时间了，吃得惯纳豆吗？
sentence.pinyin: Nǐ zhù zài Rìběn yí duàn shíjiān le, chī de guàn nàdòu ma?
sentence.english: You have lived in Japan a while; can you get used to eating natto?

repairs.note: 吃了 says you already ate it; the question asks whether you can get used to it.

items.fallbackRepair: Build 吃 + 得 + 慣.
items.sub: A：你住在日本一段時間了，…納豆嗎？

items.prompt: Complete B's reply with V不慣 or V慣了.

sentence.traditional: 那種獨特的味道，我到現在還是吃不慣。

sentence.pinyin: Nà zhǒng dútè de wèidao, wǒ dào xiànzài hái shì chī bú guàn.
sentence.english: That unique taste, I still can't get used to eating it.

repairs.note: 慣了 says you have got used to it; B still cannot, so use 不慣.

items.fallbackRepair: Build 吃 + 不 + 慣.
items.sub: A：你住在日本一段時間了，…納豆嗎？

situation.traditional: 你同學的父母不同意他一個人去國外，當一個月的背包客，他們還大吵了一架。你怎麼跟同學說？

sentence.english: After all, you didn't know about this.
